svg.title: News and recompute
svg.desc: News reaches the root, goes down by relevance to the rates path, and the change climbs back up through every decision resting on it.

text.tspan: Every decision is recorded with what it rests on. News arrives at the root.
Down by relevance: the root judges the news touches the rates path,
which Financing asked for. Demand is left alone.
Rates path re-decides in its own session. It changed, so the harness
notes every node resting on it: Financing and Expression.
Financing and Expression re-decide, and the root follows.
Four decisions now have a second version that says what changed it.
